kind: Locale-aware in-memory File Info category collision resolution
scope: Four fresh isolated Edge/native processes with first File Info per initialized owned component. UI-only overall tracing enabled/disabled in ABBA order; no catalog observer or message-pressure fixture.
limitations: Not installed-app or personal-browser acceptance; no fresh paired IDM timing. Installed UDM remains 7.11.
Trace-off omits overall callbacks but component per-control timers still run in both modes; neither mode is fully uninstrumented production.
Two samples per mode describe observations, not a reliable latency distribution or an optimization proof.
GetThreadTimes CPU accounting is coarse. Zero deltas do not prove a wait; only same-thread deltas are reported. Nested control timings must not be added to totals.
The 15 ms observer may see actionable state after actual paint. First File Info follows component/bridge initialization and is not a full production cold start.
Exact output comes from completed prefetch, not metadata prediction.
observerCorrection: See file-info-trace-interpretation-7.63.json: historical catalog hooks observed ordinary saves and did not inject writes.
change: Resolve collisions against previously inserted labels in memory using the actual selector locale, equal UTF-16 lengths and Windows case-insensitive comparison. Empty queries do not match; comparison errors fall back to native search. Native insertion and key selection remain unchanged.
cleanup: Generated payloads, closed profiles/staged extensions and fixture object removed individually after hashing. See category-labels-7.65-cleanup.json.
interpretation: Historical and new samples are unpaired and small. Report category phase and whole-dialog observations separately; no installed or IDM speed equivalence is inferred.
build: All five production targets and three owned UI fixtures; see category-labels-7.65-build.json.
nativeOracle: The standalone owned Win32 probe checks 34 queries across six locale entries (five distinct on this machine). The component fixture separately compares all generated collision labels with native combo searches and counts native searches during the product helper.
